summary: Full backend + frontend QA of the Epsilon Executive Education landing page. 10/10 backend pytest tests pass (root, brochure CRUD-style, callback CRUD-style, validation, persistence, no _id leak). Frontend tested at 1920px (desktop), 768px (tablet), and 390px (mobile). All 18 requested feature/bug scenarios verified including: dark hero with light brochure form, no 'Cohort 01' text, static faculty logo grid (7 logos, no marquee), 6 audience icon-cards (no numbers), gold curriculum CTA (rgb(197,160,89)), 4 placement stats, video modal with iframe, nav + footer social icons (all 4 each), sticky mobile CTA hidden at desktop and visible at mobile (with valid tel: and wa.me hrefs), 15s-delayed popup with sessionStorage gating, end-to-end brochure and callback form submissions persisting to MongoDB via the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Zero console errors across all viewports.

issues: At exactly 768px wide the desktop nav is on but cramped: the 'FAQ' link visually overlaps the first social icon (renders like 'FAQ©'), and the right-hand 'Apply now' button gets clipped at the viewport edge. Recommend tightening nav link spacing or hiding social icons until lg breakpoint.

action_items: Optional: tighten Navbar layout at 768px so FAQ text doesn't overlap social icons and 'Apply now' button doesn't clip (e.g. move desktop nav to lg: breakpoint, or reduce horizontal padding/gap between links).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: BrochureLead.created_at and CallbackLead.created_at are typed as str via default_factory(.isoformat()), while StatusCheck.timestamp is datetime. Inconsistent; consider a unified datetime field with isoformat conversion at insert time (matches existing pattern in create_status_check).
server.py: list endpoints don't paginate; .to_list(500) is a hard cap. Acceptable for an MVP, but should be paginated for production lead lists.

server.py: no auth/protection on GET /api/leads/brochure and GET /api/leads/callback - lead data (name/email/phone) is publicly readable on the deployed URL. HIGH PRIORITY for production (PII exposure).

PopupForm.jsx: sessionStorage flag is set when the timer fires (not when user submits/closes). Combined with the unmount cleanup this is fine, but consider also setting the flag on close to be explicit.

Hero.jsx + PopupForm.jsx: API base URL constructed as `${process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/api` at module load; works correctly but a small shared `lib/api.js` axios instance would DRY this across components.
test_credentials: N/A - public landing page, no auth required
seed_data_creation: Pytest run created a handful of TEST_-prefixed records in db.brochure_leads and db.callback_leads (uuid-suffixed). Browser tests also created TEST_UI_<timestamp> brochure lead and TEST_Popup_<timestamp> callback lead. No production-like data was modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints pass and persistence is verified. Frontend critical flows (hero brochure form -> /api/leads/brochure, 15s popup -> /api/leads/callback, video modal, sticky mobile CTAs, no 'Cohort 01' string, static faculty grid, gold curriculum button, icon-based audience cards, social icons in nav+footer) all pass. Only open observation is minor tablet (768px) navbar cramping. Pop-up uses sessionStorage key 'epsilon_popup_shown_v1' - clear it between visibility tests. GET /api/leads/brochure and /api/leads/callback are unauthenticated and return PII - main agent should consider gating these for production.
rca of the issue: No bugs to RCA - implementation matches the PRD. The only finding is a minor responsive layout polish at the 768px breakpoint in Navbar.jsx where the full desktop nav (links + social icons + Apply CTA) becomes too wide for the available space; raising the desktop nav breakpoint to lg (1024px) or condensing spacing would fix it.
